x_axis.method: left/right frame border pixel columns, confirmed against x=0 and x=5 tick label positions

y_axis.method: major tick-mark pixel rows detected via dark-pixel run search inside left frame; 3-point linearity confirmed self-consistent (1540,1681,1963.5 exactly linear in 0.2-unit steps)

marker_color_identification.method: exact RGB histogram of a clean data-region strip, cross-checked against ROOT legend swatch colors

marker_detection_method: scipy.ndimage connected-component labeling on a color-distance mask (L1 distance < 30 from pure marker color), filtered by blob shape (area 10-35px, width/height 4-9px) and a y-pixel-range window derived from the axis calibration to exclude title text, legend text/swatches, and axis tick marks.
legend_swatch_exclusion: One red blob at (px=1788.3, py=1672.7) was excluded as the legend icon for Tight Primary -- its y-position (efficiency approx 1.06, outside the 0.6-1.2 plotted data range entirely) is inconsistent with the descending data sequence, confirming it is not a data point.
independent_second_check: Re-ran detection with a looser color-distance tolerance (60 instead of 30). Identical marker counts (17/17 for both curves); centroid shift <0.002 GeV in pT and <0.0001 in efficiency between the two tolerance settings -- confirms robustness, not a second independent digitization method in the strictest sense (no second analyst/tool was available), disclosed as such.

validation_against_printed_constraints.plateau_claim: Paper text (p.5): Above pT>=5 GeV, the track reconstruction efficiency reaches a plateau equal to ~90% and ~85% respectively for the Loose and Tight Primary selections.
validation_against_printed_constraints.assessment: Consistent with the printed ~90%/~85% plateau claim to within ~0.5-1 percentage point -- NOT forced to match; this is the natural output of the pixel calibration and marker detection.
validation_against_printed_constraints.note_on_Table_1_values: Table 1 values (91%/73%/86%/63%) are eta-BINNED, pT-INTEGRATED over [0.4,20]GeV -- a DIFFERENT slicing than this pT-differential digitization, so they are NOT directly comparable and no forced comparison was attempted.

uncertainty_disclosure.pixel_level_precision: approx 1 pixel corresponds to approx 0.007 GeV in pT and approx 0.0014 in efficiency (from the calibration formula) -- this is a DIGITIZATION-READOUT precision only.
uncertainty_disclosure.NOT_INCLUDED: The systematic uncertainty BANDS shown in the original figure (light gray/pink shaded regions) were NOT digitized in this pass -- only the central marker values. Any use of these values in an implementation would currently have NO associated systematic uncertainty unless the bands are digitized separately.

label: DIGITIZED APPROXIMATION FROM A GRAPHICAL SOURCE -- NOT exact printed numeric data (contrast with Table 1's four printed percentages, which ARE exact). Central marker positions only; uncertainty bands not digitized.
